info.title: OIC development custody API
info.description: One institution/environment per deployment. TLS termination and credential provisioning are domain-local. Bearer capabilities are vault-scoped and never replace independent signed approvals. HTTP success is not chain finality. No arbitrary-signing, key-import, or administrative-update endpoint is exposed. See spec/protocol-v1.md for the canonical security encoding and current production limitations.

post.summary: Build an immutable direct-transfer intent (propose capability)
post.description: Requires a nonblank external_reference, schema_version 1, and proposer_credential_id matching the bearer credential. Idempotency is scoped to institution and route and retained for the operation lifecycle. Same key/different canonical intent conflicts. Success returns a built candidate, not authorization or submission.

get.summary: Read stored candidate, grants, and completed issuance (read capability)

get.description: The approval client must verify trust roots and decode native bytes itself; display text from this API is not authorization.

200.description: ApprovalPackage from oic-domain-types, independently verified by oic-approve

post.summary: Store an independent signed grant (approve capability)
post.description: Signer, intent, and institution/environment/vault bindings and signature/expiry are checked. Submission and signers re-evaluate applicability and quorum. Recording a grant does not claim the operation is approved. Same grant ID/body is idempotent while accepting grants; conflicting reuse fails.

post.summary: Authorize, sign, and record a broadcast attempt (submit capability)
post.description: 200 promises durable completed issuance evidence, not RPC acknowledgement, inclusion, or finality. Follow getOperation and refreshOperation. Lost ACK retries reuse exactly the signed bytes. Dispatching without completed issuance returns ISSUANCE_UNCERTAIN and never automatically signs again.

post.summary: Cancel only before API dispatch (propose capability)
post.description: Idempotent after cancellation. Never revokes an already issued native signature; a started or ambiguous dispatch cannot be cancelled.

get.summary: Read operational lifecycle and submission evidence (read capability)

200.description: Latest stored state; no RPC polling is implied

issuance.description: Coordinator transition summary, not a release receipt

submission.description: Broadcaster record with attempts and observation evidence

post.summary: Poll configured chain evidence and record observed lifecycle (submit capability)

200.description: Observed lifecycle; only FINALIZED_SUCCESS denotes final success under the enrolled profile

get.summary: Read API intent, candidate, grants, envelope, receipt and signed bytes (read capability)
Read monitored holdings minus outstanding reservations (read capability)
get.description: Holdings are not policy allowance or proof of beneficial ownership. Missing monitoring/cursor is not a live-chain balance assertion.

get.summary: Replay signed operational observations (read access to all catalog vaults)
get.description: Ascending institution-global sequence strictly after the supplied cursor. Verify signatures against independently pinned event keys, persist cursor after processing, deduplicate repeats, and replay gaps. These are observations, not a transactional issuance audit; webhook push/key rotation are not implemented.

200.description: Empty array at the current end; cursor is the last processed body.sequence

get.summary: Export operational journal/evidence and authority checkpoint (read access to all catalog vaults)
get.description: Contains no custody shares. Full reconstruction additionally needs individual API operation evidence, other producers' issuance records, and the declared chain evidence. This is not a cross-store atomic backup or a recovery package.

200.description: Versioned OperationsExport and signed authority checkpoint

bearerAuth.description: Random capability token, provisioned/revoked domain-locally; SHA-256 hash stored by the API. Not an approval signature.

Id.name: id
Id.description: Intent ID, operation-family ID, or chain-wallet ID as named by the route

IntentRecord.description: Stored candidate/approval/dispatch evidence, not a finality assertion

Error.description: 400 invalid input, 401 invalid bearer, 403 forbidden scope/signature, 404 absent resource, 409 conflict/policy/uncertainty, 503 storage/recovery unavailable, or 500 internal failure. Inspect operation evidence before retrying a mutation.

built.description: BuiltCandidate: native candidate, verified effects, ApprovalPackage and preview commitment; typed source is oic-service-builder

issuance.description: Completed coordinator Issuance: envelope, release_receipt, issuance_record, signed (verified signed native transaction)
